checkpoint_measurement.description: Bounded deterministic measurements from an adapted VGG-8 checkpoint on selected CIFAR-10 test examples.
checkpoint_measurement.label: independent_checkpoint_measurement

eq76_projection.description: Measures the Eq. 76 column-space condition and separately checks the same-sample bias-free linear-map identity.
eq76_projection.label: checkpoint_condition_measurement

gaussian_surrogate.description: Gaussian ReLU moments evaluated from measured marginal or pair moments; fit error is diagnostic and is not a pass condition.
gaussian_surrogate.label: paper_formula_with_empirical_moments

shuffle_witness.description: A deterministic permutation preserves each selected marginal while changing its pairing with another channel.
shuffle_witness.label: deterministic_dependence_counterexample

reproduction_scope.claim: Independent bounded audit of BN marginal state, Gaussian surrogate fit, dependence non-identification, and the Eq. 76 projection condition.
reproduction_scope.dataset_route: CIFAR-10 test split, not the paper ImageNet experiment
limitations: One checkpoint cannot establish behavior across architectures or training runs.
Spatial positions and examples are deterministically bounded samples.
Empirical pair covariance is used only to isolate Gaussian shape error.
No pruning, compression, fine-tuning, or accuracy comparison is performed.
reproduction_scope.model_route: adapted VGG-8 with a 10-class CIFAR-10 head
